name: magdev/php-assimp
scope: One mesh with three vertices and one face reported from a valid local ASCII PLY triangle
family: Assimp native PLY loader through magdev/php-assimp CLI wrapper
family_note: The PHP 0.3.2 package invokes the external Assimp 6.0.6 CLI and returns its format-aware info output. It is a distinct PHP package path but shares Assimp PLY parsing with C/C++ paths. Version 0.6.0 is separately recorded as failing.

name: collectiveaccess/providence
input_api: PlyToStl::convert(local ASCII PLY path, local STL output path); parses vertex coordinates and face indices
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle; converted STL contains one parsed facet, three vertices and the second X coordinate
family_note: Providence exposes a PHP parser class in app/lib/Parsers. Its conversion path reads PLY vertex and face rows; the adapter supplies a no-op file for an unused Db.php include. Search hits containing copied PlyToStl.php files are not counted as separate packages without independent release and API verification.

name: ahg/3d-model

family: Heratio pure PHP PLY header metadata extractor
family_note: Distinct ahg/3d-model Composer library within the Heratio monorepo. Extracts PLY-specific header counts directly in PHP, without Assimp or Providence code.
